title: Similar: Transmission Contingency Flow Redistribution
goal: Run DC power flow on a transmission snapshot for an intact-grid case and a specified single-line outage case, then compare bus angles, branch flows, overloads, and the branches with the largest absolute flow redistribution in a structured report.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the core dc-power-flow workflow: build the susceptance matrix, map non-contiguous bus IDs, anchor the slack bus, recompute flows after a topology change, and compare line loading between two scenarios.
